notes.title: Updated!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Recently, there have been some unexpected events. When compiling the game, the system crashed, and the project was damaged. It took a lot of time to fix the project because it was too large, making the recovery process very tedious. However, most of the issues have been overcome. Updates:

The hit feel has been redone, now slashing monsters will be very smooth.

Changed the undead hero to a vampire to increase visual recognition and expand skill performance.

Changed the attack level scenes, completely modified the terrain templates.

During the battle, pressing Tab will open the skill editor where you can edit combos. Currently, infinite skill points are given, highly recommended for trial.

Adjustment: Building functions are separated into castle construction (will not be damaged in battle, feel free to build) and frontline fortress (may be damaged in battle).

Known issues:

Many resources are missing, previously they worked well, but now they are displayed incorrectly, had to temporarily shield them, will fix in the next version.

Text loss, this problem still exists, but I have found a solution, will fix in the next version.

For the vampire faction, currently only one hero can be used, the resources of other heroes are displayed incorrectly, working on it.

The difficulty curve still has issues, but this work needs to be adjusted along with the fixed attack levels, updates will be gradual.

Bosses oddly do not cast skill effects anymore, but note that the damage is still there.

Next version plans:

Supplement hero resources and skills.

Supplement unit resources and talents.

The original units made the operation too complex, will greatly revise the functions.

Gradually update the combat values of each hero and unit.
